terms.name: ThermalEnergyCarrier

terms.name: TimeSeries
terms.label: Time Series
terms.comment: A sequence of data points indexed in time order, typically used to represent dynamic attributes over time
terms.definition: A time series is a series of data points indexed (or listed or graphed) in time order. Time series data is used to track changes over time for dynamic attributes.
examples: Hourly electricity demand for 2024; a 48-hour wind speed forecast

terms.name: TransportProcess
terms.label: Transport Process

examples: Pumping water through a pipe; transmitting electricity over a line

terms.name: TransportProcessAttribute
terms.label: Transport Process Attribute
terms.comment: Typing marker grouping attributes that apply to a Transport Process; lets SPARQL select all attributes of one component type via rdfs:subClassOf*

terms.name: Turbine
terms.label: Turbine
terms.comment: Rotary energy converter extracting mechanical work from a moving fluid
examples: A wind turbine in a wind park; a steam turbine in a CHP plant
terms.scopeNote: A WindTurbine extension class belongs here (under Turbine), while the wind park it stands in is a Location and the wind it harvests is a Wind resource.

terms.name: TurbineAttribute
terms.label: Turbine Attribute
terms.comment: Typing marker grouping attributes that apply to a Turbine; lets SPARQL select all attributes of one component type via rdfs:subClassOf*

terms.name: UnitBasedCostAttribute

terms.name: Valve
terms.label: Valve

terms.name: Wind
terms.label: Wind Resource

terms.scopeNote: Use for the wind resource itself. A wind park (the site) maps to Location; a wind turbine (the machine) maps to Turbine; forecast wind speeds are DynamicAttributes with a FutureTimeSeries.

terms.label: Wind Resource Attribute
terms.comment: Typing marker grouping attributes that apply to a Wind; lets SPARQL select all attributes of one component type via rdfs:subClassOf*

terms.scopeNote: Written by the platform scenario tooling together with usedInScenario; the override carries the new value while the superseded replica attribute keeps the baseline value.
